description: This file contains domain-specific service functions for managing teams, projects, boards, columns, tasks, comments, notifications, and related rollups in a task management backend system. It provides CRUD operations, validation, and business logic for handling entities and their interactions within the project management context.

methods.name: HTTPException _not_found(entity: str)
methods.description: Helper to raise 404 error when an entity is not found.

methods.name: HTTPException _conflict(msg: str)
methods.description: Helper to raise 409 conflict error with a message.

methods.name: HTTPException _bad_request(msg: str)
methods.description: Helper to raise 400 bad request error with a message.

methods.name: m.TeamMembership _ensure_team_member(db: Session, team_id: UUID, user_id: UUID)
methods.description: Checks if a user is a team member, raises 403 if not.

methods.name: m.Team create_team(db: Session, name: str, created_by_user_id: Optional[UUID])
methods.description: Creates a new team and optionally adds the creator as admin.

methods.name: m.TeamMembership add_team_member(db: Session, team_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, actor_user_id: UUID, role_in_team: str)
methods.description: Adds a user to a team with a specific role, only admins can add members.

methods.name: List[m.TeamMembership] list_team_members(db: Session, team_id: UUID)
methods.description: Lists all members of a team.

methods.name: m.Project create_project(db: Session, team_id: UUID, name: str, actor_user_id: UUID)
methods.description: Creates a project within a team, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: m.Board create_board(db: Session, project_id: UUID, name: str, actor_user_id: UUID)
methods.description: Creates a board within a project, ensuring name uniqueness.

methods.name: m.BoardColumn create_column(db: Session, board_id: UUID, name: str, position: int, actor_user_id: UUID)
methods.description: Creates a column within a board, ensuring name and position uniqueness.

methods.name: List[m.BoardColumn] list_board_columns(db: Session, board_id: UUID)
methods.description: Lists all columns within a board, ordered by position.

methods.name: m.Task create_task( db: Session, actor_user_id: UUID, project_id: UUID, title: str, description: Optional[str], priority: str, status: str, board_id: Optional[UUID], column_id: Optional[UUID], due_date, assignee_user_ids: List[UUID], )
methods.description: Creates a task in a project, validates assignees, and updates rollups.

methods.name: m.Task get_task(db: Session, task_id: UUID, actor_user_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves a task, validating access.

methods.name: list_tasks( db: Session, actor_user_id: UUID, project_id: Optional[UUID], team_id: Optional[UUID], status_filter: Optional[str], priority_filter: Optional[str], board_id: Optional[UUID], column_id: Optional[UUID], assignee_user_id: Optional[UUID], q: Optional[str], limit: int, offset: int, )
methods.description: Lists tasks based on various filters, with total count.

methods.name: m.Task update_task( db: Session, task_id: UUID, actor_user_id: UUID, title: Optional[str], description: Optional[str], priority: Optional[str], status: Optional[str], board_id: Optional[UUID], column_id: Optional[UUID], due_date, assignee_user_ids: Optional[List[UUID]], )
methods.description: Updates task details, assignments, and related entities.

methods.name: m.TaskComment add_task_comment(db: Session, task_id: UUID, actor_user_id: UUID, body: str)
methods.description: Adds a comment to a task, notifies assignees.

methods.name: List[m.TaskComment] list_task_comments(db: Session, task_id: UUID, actor_user_id: UUID)
methods.description: Lists comments associated with a task.

methods.name: list_notifications(db: Session, actor_user_id: UUID, unread_only: bool, limit: int, offset: int)
methods.description: Lists user notifications with optional unread filter.

methods.name: m.Notification mark_notification_read(db: Session, notification_id: UUID, actor_user_id: UUID, is_read: bool)
methods.description: Marks a notification as read or unread.

methods.name: None _update_rollups_for_project(db: Session, project_id: UUID)
methods.description: Updates analytics rollup data for a project and its team.
